rules.scope: bind an explicitly grounded physically numeric field as a grouping dimension when an immediately following levels, tiers, strata, or buckets noun denotes the field's value set and the field is not an aggregate target
rules.rationale: A field's analytical role is query-dependent: explicit set discourse denotes grouping over distinct values even when the storage type is numeric.
rules.failure_condition: Comparing mean response between numeric category levels is reduced to a two-measure correlation or safe abstention.
rules.conflict_policy: Requires strong field grounding and an adjacent plural set noun; aggregate-target fields, standalone level-named measures, and unmarked dual-quantitative relations are preserved.

rules.scope: treat highest-to-lowest, lowest-to-highest, largest-first, smallest-first, ascending, and descending language as ordering direction when a ranking relation already contains one explicit aggregate score operation
rules.rationale: Ranking direction and score aggregation are orthogonal transforms. An explicit mean, median, sum, min, or max defines the score; direction language orders those scores and must not invent a second aggregate.
rules.failure_condition: Rank groups by average score from highest to lowest emits both mean and max, leaving no singular aggregation and causing validator rejection.
rules.conflict_policy: Requires a closed ranking task, a single explicit aggregate from the normalized query, and an unambiguous direction phrase; explicit max/min remains the aggregate and non-ranking superlative questions are unchanged.
